rubrics.justification: It correctly notes poor/absent ICM and TE consistent with 0DD, but it overcalls expansion as stage 2 to early 3 and says no overt degeneration, which conflicts with the provided early blastocyst/0DD grading and image showing very poor-quality morphology.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, smoking, BMI, semen, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality reasonably well, though it overinterprets the DOR label given the discordant AMH/retrieval data.

The structure is logical, but there are inconsistencies: it calls the embryo transferable/viable while downplaying the significance of a 0DD embryo, and the implantation estimate seems somewhat high for this morphology and transfer timing.

General counseling, smoking cessation, luteal support, and future-cycle review are guideline-consistent, but the morphology interpretation is not tightly aligned with Gardner 0DD and some recommendations (exercise, vitamin D/calcium, PGT-A discussion) are more generic than guideline-driven for this exact case.
Provides clear next steps for transfer support, cavity review, smoking cessation, and future stimulation reassessment; however, some advice is broad rather than highly case-specific.
